cards.card_text: Isaiah says the LORD has a day of vengeance and a year of recompense for the cause of ___.
cards.verse_text: For the LORD has a day of vengeance, a year of recompense for the cause of Zion.
cards.snippet: For the LORD has a day of vengeance, a year of recompense for the cause of Zion.

cards.card_text: His reward is with Him, and His recompense comes right along too.
cards.verse_text: His reward is with Him, and His recompense accompanies Him.
cards.snippet: His reward is with Him, and His recompense accompanies Him.

cards.card_text: Fury to His enemies, retribution to His foes, recompense to the islands.
cards.verse_text: So He will repay according to their deeds: fury to His enemies, retribution to His foes, and recompense to the islands.
cards.snippet: …to their deeds: fury to His enemies, retribution to His foes, and recompense to the islands.

cards.card_text: In His faithfulness, the LORD says He will give His people their recompense and make an everlasting covenant with them.
cards.verse_text: For I, the LORD, love justice; I hate robbery and iniquity; in My faithfulness I will give them their recompense and make an everlasting covenant with them.
cards.snippet: …hate robbery and iniquity; in My faithfulness I will give them their recompense and make an everlasting covenant with them.

cards.card_text: And the message goes on: “Look, His reward is with Him, and His recompense goes before Him.”
cards.verse_text: Look, His reward is with Him, and His recompense goes before Him.”
cards.snippet: Look, His reward is with Him, and His recompense goes before Him.”

cards.card_text: Or as the LORD puts it, Edom's recompense will return upon its own head.
cards.verse_text: As you have done, it will be done to you; your recompense will return upon your own head.
cards.snippet: As you have done, it will be done to you; your recompense will return upon your own head.
